svg.text: Generation ZX Founders
GenAI Edition
I keep coming back to the same question: who am I talking to?
The answer is the founder, the person who is already
motivated, already a minority, already up at three in the
morning building because finally they can, and it does not
matter what generation they are.
So Generation ZX is not a range of birth years. It is the people
building because finally they can. We see it most in
Generation Z and Generation X, which is why the two letters
are on the cover, but a millennial who builds at three in the
morning is one of them too.
We should say how many companies we helped along
the way. Some got created and some did not.
Dinis Cruz
The book is built in public at gen-z-developers.sgit.ai
